answer.reason: Derbe is where Paul and Barnabas fled and preached the gospel and taught many, which goes beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was where Paul and Barnabas fled, preached the gospel and taught many
clauses.quote: when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many

doubts: ACT 16:1 and ACT 20:4 only mention Timotheus and Gaius of Derbe, so they were left out as bare mentions.
